M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.subject_identity: Subject identity is canonical graph data, not authority; IDs are typed refs and never authority roots.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.authority: Normal lifecycle mutation authority resolves to the owning Subject aggregate.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.revision: Subject aggregate revision is the CAS boundary; independent Subjects do not require global serialization.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.followup: A Decision-backed parent-authorized two-root transaction mints the child inside the transaction; parent lease grants no post-commit child authority.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.completion: Completion resolves through execution_ref to Execution and then the owning Subject; no direct Completion subject_ref is required.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.cutover: Shadow graph materialization is non-authoritative; authoritative runtime lifecycle writes require a completed explicit cutover.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.binding: Zero/one/many binding is deterministic and fail-closed; ambiguity returns NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE; heuristics are denied.
M3_A_ARCHITECTURE_RECONCILIATION.recovery: Recovery is bounded mechanical read-then-repair and cannot perform semantic reasoning or trigger cutover.

sequence.requirement: Separate governance task may authorize NEXT_IMPLEMENTATION_READY_SET=M3-B1,M3-B2 after B0 acceptance; B0 does not perform this authorization.

sequence.name: B1/B2 execution
sequence.requirement: Use sibling worktrees from the accepted B0 planning commit; reconcile shared hot files before concurrent writes.

sequence.name: Foundation checkpoints
sequence.requirement: Review B3/B4/B5/B6/B7 in dependency order; keep authority non-authoritative and prefer serial integration from B6 onward.

sequence.name: Pre-cutover behavior and BG1
sequence.requirement: Accept B8/B9/B10, then evaluate BG1; only BG1 PASS can release B11.

sequence.name: Shadow validation and cutover mechanics
sequence.requirement: Run B11/B12/B13 without authority flip; B13 PASS never implies completion.

sequence.name: BG2 and post-cutover validation
sequence.requirement: Separate explicit authorization and activation evidence are required for BG2; only BG2 PASS releases B14.

sequence.name: Integration and closure
sequence.requirement: B14 evidence -> independent review -> Project Steward reconciliation -> M3 Known-Good checkpoint -> separately authorized Issue #9 closure.

Atomic commit primitive and committed-or-not enforcement.
Multi-root transaction mechanics for the frozen followup unit.
Idempotency record retention and storage mapping.
Atomic cutover record and durable authority-flip implementation.
Storage mapping for candidate and cutover records.
Projection rebuild runtime and stale-marker storage.

semantic_boundary_check.blocked_rule: If implementation discovers a true subject identity, authority, revision, CAS, transaction, lease, bootstrap/cutover, binding ambiguity, or recovery-boundary gap, stop and mark STATUS=BLOCKED; do not invent a semantic resolution in an implementation lane.

acceptance.claim_status: planning_contract_pass_only; no implementation, cutover, runtime, or authoritative-write success is claimed; guard proof applies to plan structure only
